description: Parkings données techniques is a series of datasets listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Les données techniques des parkings publics 2020 vous informe sur la capacité des parkings, leur gestionnaire, leur caractéristique... Vous pouvez les géolocaliser grâce à la couche Parking hors voirie et la mettre en relation avec le jeu de données Equipement public. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal lists 12 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, transports, stationnements, places, parkings, tramway. The portal shows 83 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-05-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
